**1.** Follow [Discord Terms of Service](https://discord.com/terms) and [Community Guidelines](https://discord.com/guidelines).

**2.** NSFW/NSFL (gore) content is strictly prohibited. This covers cropped pornography and suggestive imagery. DMs reported to staff by victims are also included.
> **2.1.** Keep all topics SFW. Sexually explicit remarks, humor, and conversations are forbidden. Inappropriate or sensitive topics are heavy offenses.
> **2.2.** No inappropriate profile content (avatars, statuses, links). If staff asks you to modify your profile and you refuse, you will be banned.

**3.** Hate against race, religion, and sexual identity is prohibited. This includes all related slurs.
> **3.1.** Discussing or posting hate group-related figures and symbols is strictly prohibited.

**4.** Behave decently to other members. Extreme harassment or hate in public channels or DMs is prohibited.

**5.** No political, religious, or divisive discussions. This server is strictly for Cold War and topics close to it (and off-topic in designated channels).
> **5.1.** No discussions of current world conflicts.

**6.** Stay on topic and use correct channels.

**7.** 'Ragebaiting' someone to the point they break rules is punishable on your end.
> **7.1.** Purposefully causing needless drama in chat falls under this rule. Know when to stop.

**8.** No spam.

**9.** Staff can warn, mute, or ban you even if you believe you have done nothing wrong. Staff will step in to shut down disruptive, toxic, or offensive behavior.
> **9.1.** Staff decisions are final and must be appealed via tickets, not debated in public channels.

**10.** No unrelated ads or shilling.
> **10.1.** Don't send random links.
> **10.2.** Ads about Cold War-related groups/channels are permitted, but **only 1x per week**.
-# ⚠️ Breaking rules can get you muted, kicked, or banned. You can only successfully appeal a mute/ban **once**.
